primary_goal: Patient-equal EZ-positive F1 > 0.65, not Macro-F1, NEZ-F1, pooled F1 or best-Outer arm. This is a target, not a promised result.
inputs: Only the existing 250Hz/500-sample waveform banks, original valid masks, cache-relative times and canonical channel/role metadata. No manual physiological measurements, D1 logits/embeddings/branch, waveform resampling, new extraction or window subsampling. Legacy mixed metadata files are opened only to read identity/roles; feature arrays never enter a model.
baseline: Shared Conv1d(1,12,9,stride4),GELU,Conv1d(12,24,7,stride4),GELU,AdaptiveAvgPool1d(1); per-window centering/populationSD floor1e-6 and clipping[-8,8]; 96->64->1 GELU unbounded NEZ head. Frozen legacy encoder/head mapping is a numerical bridge, not an unbiased new benchmark.
factor_levels: All16 Boolean combinations, fixed96 classifier slots: pre-reference is same-channel available-seizure pre-onset embedding mean; stage intervals [0,8),[8,20) or duplicated common [0,20) mean; seizure mean plus populationSD or zero SD slots; full-patient float64 Z with original SD>1e-8 denominator else1. Exact constant columns map to zero. Missing seizures excluded, no missing stage imputation. All genuine windows are encoded; no phase/window quality-based exclusion.

stage1.encoders: Existing20 own-FIT inner-cross-fitted raw-only encoders, four patient-disjoint role paths per outer fold. They saw only own inner train/cal, not choice/assessment/original Development/ownOuter labels. No legacy physiological input module is imported.
stage1.screen: LogisticRegression C1,lbfgs,max_iter2000,tol1e-7; FIT-only per-coordinate imputation/scaling, patient-equal within-class sample weights rescaled to mean1. Fit on inner train, threshold on cal, choose recipe on choice; refit on train+choice, recalibrate on cal, assess on held for screens1..3. Screen0 has no held set and provides only the deterministic final path. Frozen-CNN probes are low-cost screening, not end-to-end model results.
stage1.threshold: EZ probability grid0:0.005:1, maximize patient-average EZ-F1, then Macro-F1, then nearest0.5, then lower threshold. Also report old Macro-F1-first threshold as a decision-rule sensitivity, never choose it using Outer.
stage1.recipe_choice: Separately within each own outerFIT: average three assessment-split patient EZ-F1 minus0.1 times source-level F1 sampleSD; choose fewest active components within0.005 of maximum, then higher score, then deterministic bitstring. No global recipe chosen from overlapping folds. The 16-way assessment maximum is selection data, not unbiased validation; original Development remains unseen by stage1.
stage1.budget: 16x(3x2+1)=112 logistic fits per outer fold,560 total; no C grid, extra seeds or rerolling. Cache each patient/cell atomically and verify old baseline embedding/head parity<=1e-6 before admission. Preserve failed gates and stop rather than loosening tolerance.

stage2.budget: At most20 new full Raw training cells, original fivefold FIT/Development roles. Exact recipe aliases may reuse cells; no post-Outer rescue or new configurations.
stage2.initialization: Scratch pure Raw CNN seed42+1009fold and independent raw-only head seed+170003, identical across paired new arms. Historical physiology/D1 constructors are not instantiated. Original legacy trained checkpoints are never an initialization for new end-to-end models.
stage2.attention: A1 only: zero-output-initialized24->8->1 GELU window attention within each fixed phase and24->8->1 GELU seizure attention. Attention sees layer-normalized Raw latent only; padded entries have zero weight. Seizure weighted mean/populationSD. Initial uniform-attention output checked against non-attention pooling. This is a small architectural hypothesis; novelty has not been established by literature search.
stage2.loss_B0: Original0.75 FIT-class-weighted NEZ BCE+0.25 patient soft Macro-F1.
stage2.loss_other: 0.5 same FIT-class-weighted NEZ BCE+0.25 patient soft EZ-F1 loss+0.25 mean softplus(NEZ logit_EZ - NEZ logit_NEZ) over all within-patient EZ/NEZ pairs. No label-dependent channel sampling. If a class absent, ranking term0; report coverage.
stage2.training: AdamW lr0.0003,weight_decay0.001,clip_norm1,max30,min6,patience6,one complete patient update per epoch; FP32,TF32off; no mixed-precision change. Exact two-pass CNN gradient caching permitted only after direct/replayed full-patient logits/loss/all-gradient/RNG parity admission. No detach of full-patient Z or temporal/seizure pooling gradients.
stage2.selection: B0 original Development Macro-F1/EZ-F1/earlier epoch; other arms Development EZ-F1/Macro-F1/earlier epoch, corresponding threshold rules. Select final deployment arm per outerfold using Development EZ-F1, then Macro-F1, fewer parameters, fixed arm order. Report all four, the selected policy and threshold sensitivity; no best-Outer selection.
stage2.freeze: All20 checkpoints, own-FIT recipes, selected arms and Development-only thresholds/source/input hashes locked before any new Outer inference. Patient-level hash-bound resumable private scores sealed before Outer label reporting.

evaluation: 80 patient-equal AUROC,AP,EZ-F1,Macro-F1,NEZ-F1,ACC,MRR,Top1,EZ-fraction bias; coverage, pooled and fold/source summaries separately;10000 paired patient bootstrap draws seed42; common sampled IDs across arms. All variants on identical patients/channels/seizures. No patient exclusion by outcome or score. Old Outer extensively viewed: EXPLORATORY_REPEATED_TEST, no independent confirmation or clinical efficacy claim. Clinical onset/acquisition filter provenance remains limited to existing cache.
stage_status: Protocol fixed before the new stage1 outcomes. Stage2 implementation/admission must be frozen before stage2 training; reporting-only additions cannot alter scientific sources or frozen predictions.
delivery: Push code,hashes and anonymous aggregates/reports to GitHub. Never raw/cache/checkpoints/IDs/labels/private feature or prediction rows/runtime logs/secrets. Preserve all old research and unrelated jobs.
